answer: Agents buying cedar panels and ivory paint for a summit lodge must not blacklist a supplier just because many accounts accuse it. For automatic penalties for settlement equivocation, require two valid supplier signatures on conflicting final receipts for the same order ID under rules that forbid such a conflict. Verify the signatures and conflict locally, and process each evidence pair once. A thousand accusing aliases cannot forge that evidence. Other disputes need separate review; a stolen signing key can still produce apparently valid misconduct.
